tool_schemas.name: write-data
tool_schemas.description: Ingests a batch of time-series points into the specified bucket owned by the given organization and returns an acknowledgement with the number of points accepted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if org_id or bucket_id do not match the required ID formats, if any point is missing required fields (measurement, ts, fields), contains unknown properties, or ts is not RFC3339. Raises NOT_FOUND if the organization or bucket does not exist, and raises FORBIDDEN if the bucket is not owned by the provided org_id.

org_id.description: Organization ID that owns the target bucket.

bucket_id.description: Bucket ID to write points into.

points.description: List of time-series points to ingest.

tags.description: Tag set for the point (string key/value pairs).

fields.description: Field set for the point (numeric/string/boolean values).

ingest_source.description: Source of the ingestion for auditing.

tool_schemas.name: query-data
tool_schemas.description: Queries points from the specified bucket within the given [start, end) time window, optionally filtering by measurement and exact-match tags, and returns points sorted by timestamp along with a next_cursor when more results are available. Pagination is cursor-based: provide limit to cap the number of points returned and pass the returned cursor back as cursor to continue from the prior page in the same sort order and filters. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, invalid RFC3339 timestamps, end <= start, unsupported sort values, or malformed cursor, and raises NOT_FOUND if the organization or bucket does not exist or FORBIDDEN if the bucket is not owned by the provided org_id.

org_id.description: Organization ID that owns the target bucket.

bucket_id.description: Bucket ID to query points from.

measurement.description: If provided, only return points for this measurement.

start.description: Start time (inclusive) for the query window (RFC3339).

end.description: End time (exclusive) for the query window (RFC3339).

tags.description: Exact-match tag filters (all provided keys must match).

limit.description: Maximum number of points to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous query.

sort.description: Sort order for returned points by timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: create-bucket
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new bucket under the specified organization and returns the created bucket record including its bucket_id and retention_days (using the org default if not provided). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if org_id is malformed, name is missing/invalid, or retention_days is not an integer in the accepted range for retention settings. Raises NOT_FOUND if the organization does not exist and CONFLICT if a bucket with the same name already exists in the organization.

org_id.description: ID of the organization that will own the bucket.

retention_days.description: Retention in days for points stored in this bucket.

tool_schemas.name: create-org
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new organization and returns the created org record including its org_id and default_retention_days. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing/invalid or default_retention_days is not an integer in the accepted range for retention settings. Raises CONFLICT if an organization with the same name already exists.

default_retention_days.description: Default retention in days to apply to newly created buckets in this org when not explicitly set.

tool_schemas.name: list-orgs
tool_schemas.description: Lists organizations visible to the caller, optionally filtered by name and status, and returns a paginated result set ordered by created_at descending. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller identity cannot be resolved.

status.description: If provided, only return orgs in this lifecycle state.

name_prefix.description: If provided, only return orgs whose name begins with this prefix (case-sensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of orgs to return (default 50, max 200).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list-orgs call.

tool_schemas.name: get-org
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single organization by id and returns the org record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if org_id is malformed and NOT_FOUND if no such org exists or it is not visible to the caller.
tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_org(org_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, uuid
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0387000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0387000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    # Validate org_id
    if not isinstance(org_id, str) or not re.match(r"^influx_org_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", org_id):
        # log failed request
        reqs = _load("mcp_tool_requests.json")
        if not isinstance(reqs, list):
            reqs = []
        rid = "mcp_req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        reqs.append({
            "id": rid,
            "tool_name": "query-data",
            "request_payload": {"org_id": org_id},
            "resolved_org_id": None,
            "resolved_bucket_id": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_message": "Malformed org_id.",
            "response_summary": None,
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        })
        _save("mcp_tool_requests.json", reqs)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Malformed org_id.")

    # Create request record
    reqs = _load("mcp_tool_requests.json")
    if not isinstance(reqs, list):
        reqs = []
    rid = "mcp_req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    req_row = {
        "id": rid,
        "tool_name": "query-data",
        "request_payload": {"org_id": org_id},
        "resolved_org_id": org_id,
        "resolved_bucket_id": None,
        "status": "received",
        "error_message": None,
        "response_summary": None,
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    reqs.append(req_row)
    _save("mcp_tool_requests.json", reqs)

    req_row["status"] = "running"
    req_row["started_at"] = now
    req_row["updated_at"] = now
    _save("mcp_tool_requests.json", reqs)

    orgs = _load("orgs.json")
    if not isinstance(orgs, list):
        finished = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        req_row["status"] = "failed"
        req_row["error_message"] = "Caller identity could not be resolved."
        req_row["finished_at"] = finished
        req_row["updated_at"] = finished
        _save("mcp_tool_requests.json", reqs)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Caller identity could not be resolved.")

    org = None
    for o in orgs:
        if isinstance(o, dict) and o.get("id") == org_id:
            org = o
            break

    if org is None:
        finished = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        req_row["status"] = "failed"
        req_row["error_message"] = "Org not found."
        req_row["finished_at"] = finished
        req_row["updated_at"] = finished
        _save("mcp_tool_requests.json", reqs)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Organization not found.")

    finished = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    req_row["status"] = "succeeded"
    req_row["finished_at"] = finished
    req_row["updated_at"] = finished
    req_row["response_summary"] = {"org_id": org_id}
    _save("mcp_tool_requests.json", reqs)

    return {"org": org}

tool_schemas.name: update-org
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an organization and/or drives its lifecycle status transition, returning the updated org record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed inputs or illegal status transitions, NOT_FOUND if the org does not exist, and CONFLICT if updating name would collide with an existing org name.

default_retention_days.description: New default retention in days for future buckets created in this org.

status.description: If provided, transitions the org to this status. Allowed transitions: active→suspended/deleted, suspended→active/deleted.

tool_schemas.name: list-buckets
tool_schemas.description: Lists buckets under an organization, optionally filtered by status and name, and returns a paginated result set ordered by created_at descending. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if org_id is malformed and NOT_FOUND if the organization does not exist.

org_id.description: Organization ID whose buckets will be listed.

status.description: If provided, only return buckets in this lifecycle state.

name_prefix.description: If provided, only return buckets whose name begins with this prefix (case-sensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of buckets to return (default 50, max 200).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list-buckets call.

tool_schemas.name: get-bucket
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single bucket by id (scoped to its owning organization) and returns the bucket record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if org_id or bucket_id are malformed and NOT_FOUND if no such bucket exists in the org.

org_id.description: Organization ID that owns the bucket.

tool_schemas.name: update-bucket
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a bucket and/or drives its lifecycle status transition, returning the updated bucket record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed inputs or illegal status transitions, NOT_FOUND if the org or bucket does not exist, and CONFLICT if updating name would collide with an existing bucket name within the org.

org_id.description: Organization ID that owns the bucket.

name.description: New bucket name (must be unique within the org).

retention_days.description: New retention in days for points stored in this bucket.

status.description: If provided, transitions the bucket to this status. Allowed transitions: active→deleted.
